records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Ridge Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Welcome to Wrenfield. There's no wrong way to start -- create a project, add a few tasks, invite people, and adjust as you figure out what works for your team.

Reply here if you need a hand.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Project created day 3 and one invite sent show real momentum (facts), and Jules replies promptly though briefly [email:c92746f0]. But no key milestone in 6 days, no tickets, and engagement is thin [email:d3e73180]; 8 days left gives moderate odds of unaided activation.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Thanks for the quick reply - glad things are moving at Ridge Analytics.

Since you've got a project going, the natural next step is getting the work itself in there: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's useful, the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and you can invite more of the team from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to jump on a short call this week and help you map your current workflow into Wrenfield - just tell me a time that suits.

Best,
Nadia
